svg.title: Random-walk endpoints on a common scale
svg.desc: Bars are centered only at attainable positions of a symmetric unit-step walk, after dividing the endpoint by the square root of the number of steps. The area of each bar is its exact binomial probability. The 5-step walk has 6 possible endpoints and visibly wide bars. The 25-step walk has 26 narrower bars following the standard normal density more closely. Both panels show the same axis ranges.

g.text: Each bar’s area is the exact probability of its endpoint.
